name: MMBench-Video
description: A long-form multi-shot benchmark for holistic video understanding that incorporates approximately 600 web videos from YouTube spanning 16 major categories, with each video ranging from 30 seconds to 6 minutes. Includes roughly 2,000 original question-answer pairs covering 26 fine-grained capabilities.
reputation: Comprehensive video understanding benchmark from Shanghai AI Laboratory; covers long-form video with diverse categories; published alongside MMBench ecosystem
notes: Part of the MMBench family from Shanghai AI Laboratory. The benchmark uses temporal annotations to probe understanding across 26 fine-grained capabilities including action recognition, temporal reasoning, causal understanding, and scene understanding over long video content (30s to 6 min).

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
